name: Kounen Teruyoshi
source:
Ichibee’s little brother. Like Ichibee, he is a total warmonger. Though in his case, he is obsessed with guns. While not to the extent of his brother, he does keep his words and [spoiler]stays cool even on his death[/spoiler].
His power is to control up to 30 pistols…and fires them all at once. He originates from a youkai species named Nodeppou (a youkai said to be similar to a mixture of a tanuki, squirrel and giant flying squirrel, who wraps itself onto the face of a human who fires a gun.)

[Edited from a really spoiler-filled [url=http://whatistomato.wordpress.com/2010/12/12/chronobelt-review]Chrono Belt review[/url] by Warum]
